comment: What the required check "gate" (gate.yml) waits for before a pull request may merge (#5522). Read by tests/release/gate_check.py from the BASE commit of the pull request (gate.yml checks the base out), so a pull request cannot loosen its own gate by editing it; a change to this file is a change to the rule and needs the code owners (CODEOWNERS), like every file under .github: it is owned by the code owners (CODEOWNERS), like every file under .github. A workflow named in "always" must have a run on the PR head commit (a push to a ci/ branch, or the PR's own run, or a manual dispatch) that ended in success; one in "when" is required only when the PR changes a file matching one of its paths (the workflow's own trigger filter, copied), so a path-filtered workflow that did not run never leaves the gate pending or red.
